description:
Discover the Basso Palta III gravel bike. Our third-generation signature model, perfected for everything from racing to adventure. Featuring 52 mm tire clearance, versatile geometry, and exclusive Vibram and Apidura accessories.

Life is full of trade-offs, but your ride shouldn’t be one of them. Palta III merges two worlds into one iconic frame. Engineered for velocity, built for the long haul, and refined over three generations to ensure you never have the fear of missing out. It’s not about finding a middle ground; it’s about owning the whole map. Where will you draw the line?

Since 2018 , the Palta has carved its own path. While the industry developed gravel bikes for specific niches, we stayed true to a singular vision: uncompromising versatility. The Palta III is the total evolution of that essence. We’ve pushed every boundary, increasing lateral stiffness for explosive power, sharpening the aerodynamics for maximum efficiency against the wind, and deepening the compliance to smooth out the harshest gravel trails.

With expanded tire clearance, internal storage and the refinement of our signature Palta geometry , we aren’t here to define gravel for you. We’re giving you all the tools to define it for yourself. All in one bike.

At 970g , Palta III is our lightest gravel platform to date. We’ve reimagined the carbon layup to maximize power transfer and sharpen handling when the pace hits its peak. By leveraging our road bikes R&D, we’ve reduced frontal aerodynamic impact by 18% . Whether you are hunting a podium or deep into a weekend adventure, this efficiency saves your energy for when the smooth gravel ends and the real challenge begins.

Palta III’s expanded tire clearance allows for wider tires and lower pressures, maximizing grip and smoothing out long-distance journeys. The increased sloping geometry works in harmony with our Diamante seatpost and 3B Clamp System Gen II, creating an integrated system that absorbs shock and vibration. With two seatpost setbacks and three cockpit options, traditional or integrated, the Palta III is a platform tuned to your exact anatomy.

If you are looking for ultimate comfort or you like to get very technical with your gravel, the new Strato Stem and Carbon Gravel Handlebar is for you. Strato Stem: New stem clamping system -8° stem angle. 6 sizes available Compatible with all Basso EcoSystem accessories Carbon Gravel Handlebar: Full carbon with 12° flare and 122 mm drop 4 sizes available

To meet the diverse needs of riders, the Palta is compatible with Fuga Integrated Handlebar. Optimized for aerodynamic position and for narrow-shouldered riders 300g of weight Features a 1° back sweep and down sweep for enhanced comfort and neutral wrist position Short 65mm reach for optimal lever/handlebar integration Compatible with all Basso EcoSystem accessories

For those who prefer a more classic cockpit geometry Levita Integrated Handlebar offers seamless compatibility and additional customization options in 330g of weight. Handlebar tape integration Available in 10 differnt stem and handlebar width combinations Compatible with all Basso EcoSystem accessories

Palta III features an internal downtube storage system designed to house your essentials in two dedicated bags, all secured by a color-matched carbon cover and a Fidlock magnetic locking system. To ensure your frame is as resilient as your spirit, we’ve collaborated with Vibram to develop a custom bash guard for maximum protection against rock strikes and complemented by a set of bespoke Apidura x Basso packs . Palta III is fully equipped to carry your ambition from the start line to the deep wild.
